name: Adani Electricity Mumbai Ltd., Distribution (AEML-D)
source: MERC MYT Order for AEML-D, Case No. 211 of 2024 (28 March 2025), Tariff Schedule, LT I(B) for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 (page 452).

bill_inputs.label: Fuel adjustment charge (FAC)
bill_inputs.note: Changes every month. We use the FAC printed on your bill, and ₹0 if it isn't shown.

bill_inputs.label: Tax on sale of electricity
bill_inputs.note: A Government of Maharashtra levy per unit. We use the rate printed on your bill, and ₹0 if it isn't shown.

net_metering.note: Under MERC net metering, extra units are banked for later months. Units left at year end are bought at a low rate, so we count them as ₹0.

common_area.note: Housing societies' separately metered common facilities (water pumping, common-area lighting, lifts, parking, fire-fighting pumps) are billed on LT-I(B) Residential, clause (c).
common_area.source: MERC MYT Order for AEML-D, Case No. 211 of 2024 (28 March 2025), Tariff Schedule, LT I(B) applicability (c) (page 451); section 2.12 (page 43): no separate LT category for co-operative housing societies.
